questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Watch for children crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down in wet conditions. Avoid sudden braking or sharp turns. Leave more space between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming up. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be prepared to stop or follow the light's instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Then go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Only proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help communicate. If the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells you the road has many curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot avoid cars, so you must always let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. Either action could make you lose control. Stay calm and ease back onto the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you the direction traffic must go on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out to the left is a hand signal meaning the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves in a row.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed to drive when exiting a highway. The number on the sign (for example, 30 mph) is the recommended maximum speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved for left turns only. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or for through-traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a school zone is approaching. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs give orders that drivers must follow. This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic from the right will be merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will make a sharp turn to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.
